items.title: What we calculate
items.text: Workload peaks and resource demand for RAMP/PAX processing based on your flight schedule and SLA/engagement standards.

items.title: Usage areas
items.text: Hub feasibility validation, network planning, seasonal schedule adjustments, and data-driven ground handling negotiations.

items.title: What you get
items.text: Customizable dashboards with 35+ metrics, BI integration, and smart reports that help you identify and fix risks before go-live.

rows.title: Upload your flight schedule in any format
paragraphs: The platform instantly builds a unified workload model, aligning your network planning and operations teams from the start.

image.alt: Uploaded flight schedule overview: flights, movements, passengers and peak hour, with flights per airline over time and the schedule list

rows.title: Apply specific handling rules
paragraphs: Accurately calculate precise staffing and equipment needs for every single turn to avoid under- or over-resourcing.

image.alt: Handling rules by airline with task start and end times, staff quantity, colours and qualifications

rows.title: Predict and block delay risks before they hit you
paragraphs: See exactly which flight banks will overload your ground handlers and create operational bottlenecks.

image.alt: FlightPrint flight plan: flights on a timeline with handling tasks and the workload curve showing peaks

rows.title: Generate clear, data-driven dashboards
paragraphs: For confident, evidence-based negotiations with handlers and hubs or seamlessly sync everything with Power BI.

image.alt: FlightPrint report: flights, FTE, heads, worked and paid hours with charts by day and aircraft type

items.title: Full visibility
items.text: Access 35+ metrics for full visibility across ramp, gate, and pax handling to replace manual estimates.

items.title: Accurate contracts
items.text: Align handling agreements with actual needs based on validated, modelled demand to ensure contract accuracy.

items.title: Validated capacity
items.text: Validate seasonal capacity well before go-live to spot hub pressure points and operational risks early.

items.title: Unified data
items.text: Unify data for airline network planners, ops, and handlers to drive explainable slot planning & leadership decisions.
